title: Purpose and architecture
content:
Local document test
  Generated DOCX -> Word -> loopback receiver
  -> SQLite event -> classification -> console alert

Separate cloud test
  Controlled HTTPS request -> Azure receiver
  -> Table Storage event -> notification outcome
  -> DCR -> CanaryHit_CL -> scheduled rule -> Sentinel incident
meaning: Extended the local document-token receiver with Azure Table Storage and Sentinel ingestion. Word and cloud callbacks were exercised separately.

title: Starting state and baseline
meaning: Recorded the local SQLite starting point and nine passing baseline tests before adding the Azure adapters.

title: Infrastructure deployment
meaning: Deployed the Bicep resources successfully. Resource identifiers and endpoint values are omitted from the saved response.
